scope: Independent request/history/store integration and CLI/MCP review, with regression fixes and scoped re-reviews.

findings.problem: Generic publication allowed working-file journal and imported candidate paths outside immutable store storage.
findings.fix: Store publication now enforces exact content-addressed journal/candidate paths under its explicit store folder.
findings.review: fixed; nested custom stores and no-extension/bin/PNG cases also passed

findings.problem: History replay accepted backward event instants.
findings.fix: Compare timezone-aware event instants with preparation and preceding events.

findings.problem: Credential defaults hidden in schema applicators or fragment references escaped exclusion.
findings.fix: Carry credential context through schema applicators and local references using a network-disabled resolver.
findings.review: fixed; anchor, chained reference, recursive optional credential and root-id probes also passed

findings.problem: Timestamp parsing discarded precision beyond microseconds and could conceal backward time.
findings.fix: Reject more than six fractional digits; document supported precision.

findings.problem: MCP schema validation errors echoed malformed authorization values before request validation.
findings.fix: Return only the schema validation keyword, without instance data.
findings.review: fixed; 10 job-operation/MCP tests passed in final scoped review

additional_development_regressions: Imported candidate was absent from job context; J.xs now preserves typed closure.
Import initially checked only F hash; complete output semantic scope is now required.
limitations: Review is bounded to this local operation.
No real provider, visual or target-engine execution.
Final formatting changes were followed by the integrated test suite; review findings and their corrections were checked separately.
